Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood. I’m Jordan from our PLG outreach team — I’ll coordinate the 30-min hosted API eval and sandbox walk-through. Quick questions so we make the session high-signal:

- Do you want the session to focus more on latency/cost optimizations or on integration (SDKs + auth + quickstart)?
- Are there particular endpoints (chat vs. streaming vs. embeddings) you want to test?

I have these windows (PT) available over the next two business days:
- Tue 5/14: 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 5/15: 09:30–10:00 or 13:00–13:30

If those don’t work, tell me three times that do and I’ll book. I’m copying Dylan (ops) and Grace (developer advocacy) — they’ll join to cover sandbox provisioning and an SDK demo.

If you prefer self-serve first, here’s a short runbook we often share; I’ll attach a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

Next steps:
1) Pick a time or reply with preferred times.
2) Share a sample prompt or dataset snippet if you want us to preload it.

Thanks —
